name: FUNKY DRUMMER
source: James Brown, "Funky Drummer" (1970), Clyde Stubblefield's break in Wikipedia's excerpt, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Funky_Drummer_sample.ogg . The recording is under copyright, so the audio stays out of the repo: save that file here as funky.ogg (git ignores it), then node tools/make-kit.mjs kits/funky. The excerpt is 64 kbps, so the top end is dull, which suits boom bap. The break plays 16ths at about 101 BPM, so most pads run a 16th, from their attack to just before the next hit. KICK SNARE is one beat: the kick, a hat, then the snare.
